notes.title: Melee Multiplayer update
notes.content:
Update 37 - Melee in Multiplayer, New Intro Cinematic,  and more

Hey Gun World Team, it's time to save the world. Your government has called you to join the squad. We've added a new intro cinematic to Gun World and you will now be able to play this in the main menu map, as well as the first time you load Gun World VR on your headset. We've always wanted to add a backstory to Gun World and now with an intro cinematic, we believe that we've done just that. We've also added melee mechanics for multiplayer mode - you can now use all of the 25 melee weapons from sandbox mode in multiplayer. Relive your best moments in B&S but in multiplayer, here in Gun World VR. Let's get into the fray Gun World Team.

Main Features:
-added new Intro Cinematic that gives a background story to Gun World
-added new melee weapon mechanics to Multiplayer mode - you can now select melee weapons in the class spawner
-added melee weapon inventory slot to holster your melee weapon
-added all 25 of the melee weapons to multiplayer mode
-made multiplayer NPCs have collision and be hittable by melee weapons
-added pistol and revolver to the main weapon category selector for the Assault class and CQB expert class, for those who want to equip pistols as a main weapon in multiplayer mode

Changes:
-made secondary weapon to spawn directly into your holsters in multiplayer mode, for a smoother multiplayer experience
-slightly sped up traveling to lobby time after completing a multiplayer game or mission
-removed the rank name system temporarily, made your name display your oculus name instead
-added more fixes to physics issues that may be causing crashes in multiplayer mode
-fixed issue where bullet casing would still remain in the chamber of the gun after emptying the magazine.

notes.title: PvP Mega Update
notes.content:
Update 36 - PvP mega update -  8 new PvP modes, new PvP maps, new mines, and new Rank and XP system

Hey everyone, the PvP Mega Update is now officially out, let's get tactical with each other! We've added 8 new game modes and 3 new PvP maps, all for you to test out your amazing PvP skills and tactics. There is now an official XP and leveling system in Gun World VR, where you can rank up and earn credits. You will soon be able to spend your credits for awesome things in the future, so lets see how many credits you can earn in Gun World VR!

[previewyoutube=aLlRVZY52Mk;full][/previewyoutube]

-Tons of new PvP multiplayer mechanics

notes.title: Multiplayer Mega Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40958461/07ae68bbd6b387103b3f21b7d07ebc75e6809618.png

Update 34 - Multiplayer Mega Update and lots more

Hey everyone, it's Anthony from Gun World here, let me show you what's new. Tons of stuff have been added to multiplayer, with most of the guns now being multiplayer compatible, and two new maps being added. I've also made it such that you should be able to cross play between Quest and PCVR users. Less go!

Main Features: 
-New Inventory slot system and slot customizer
-New MP40 (PDW)
-New multiplayer classes
-New Doors and door breaching mechanics
-New Multiplayer maps and tons of multiplayer improvements
-New Flashbang grenade and flashbang mechanics for players and even AI
-New AI enemies and weapons, AI can have ballistic shields and even machine guns and shotguns
-New Multiplayer Gun Vault system, bring your gun saves to multiplayer
-New Door Breaching equipment and CQB equipment (battering ram, mirror gun, tactical mirror, ballistic shields, C4)
-New trip wire traps and wire cutters
-New Voice command system (press and hold right thumbstick to activate)

New:
-Added inventory slot customizer in settings map, you can have full customization of inventory positioning and even rotation
-Added new inventory slot system, you now have designated inventory slots for mags, guns, pistols, equipment, back slot etc, instead of a general slot that accepts everything
-Added new grenade explosion effects
-Added player ragdoll effect on death
-Added player getting hit reaction animation in multiplayer
-Added new gun MP40 (PDW)
-Added new Doors and door mechanics, door bolt, and door busting mechanics
-Added almost all weapons to be multiplayer compatible
-Added kicking ability (press and hold jump button to kick)
-Added Mirror Gun (breaching cam) 
-Added M84 Flashbang, new flashbang mechanics, and AI enemies reacting to flashbang effects
-Added extra Gun Vault Save slots to a total of 80 Gun Vault save slots
-Added new Wire Cutter, Pipe bomb tripwires, and new wire cutting mechanics
-Added new Multiplayer Class selection system and weapon selection system
-Added new Multiplayer gun Vaults, you can now save and bring your favourite gun loadouts to, multiplayer (it must be saved in the Multiplayer vault first)
-Added ability to select your Gun Vault guns directly when choosing a gun in the spawner (eg, when picking AK103, your AK103 vault saves will appear at the far right and bottom section of the spawner UI, below the attachments section)
-Added C4 and ability to blow up doors
-Added tons of new AI enemies and AI guns, new AI shooting mechanics, and AI with ballistic shields
-Added Ballistic shield that players can use (Under Tactical equipment, as well as back equipment slot for multiplayer class selector)
-Added tactical mirror that players can use to check corners
-Added more features to the multiplayer hosting room selection UI and multiplayer lobby UI
-Added new CQB breaching training room in the multiplayer waiting room when waiting for players
-Added new Embassy Siege multiplayer map 
-Added new Escape from Gun World multiplayer map
-Added tons of weapons to multiplayer
-Added voice commands (press and hold right thumbstick to activate command UI wheel)

Changes:
-Fixed shooting range button not working issue
-Fixed issue where swapping hands when holding a gun causes left hand to glitch out
-Slightly increased movement acceleration and deceleration for more snappy movement
-Fixed issue where some guns sound the same and aren't using new gun sounds
-Fixed MP5 charging handle glitch where you can pull it out of the gun
-Fixed issue where sprite explosions would follow player head rotation
-Fixed not being able to turn items when using sandbox spawner mode 
-Changed Player Multiplayer health to 180 
-Increased Voice Chat volume to 6x
-Added tons of optimisations behind the scenes, players should feel a more smoother gameplay experience overall in many areas, especially in multiplayer

Join our Discord for full details: https://discord.gg/zdX9PCt

notes.title: Update 31 - Mag palming, muzzle smoke, tracer wiggle, PP Vityaz, and more!
notes.content:
Hey everybody, it's Anthony from Gun World here. Lets check out the new update!

The main focus of this update would be the new mag palming mechanic which I think will make reloading more realistic in Gun World. This update will be a bridge before we head into the survival mode for Gun World. I've added more improvements and a new PP Vityaz, full details in update-changelog. Less go.

Update is only available on the alpha1 branch. Switch to alpha1 branch to access it as it uses OpenXR.

[previewyoutube=Sf0pxjGskZw;full][/previewyoutube]

Main Features:
-new mag palm mechanic (hold mag near gun and press X with left hand)
-new muzzle smoke effect and tracer wiggle effect for bullets
-new PP19 Vityaz (PDW)
-new gun malfunction mechanic for most auto weapons (occurs for 1 in 5000 shots)
-new backpack mechanic showcase
-human shooting enemies can now be grabbed and are physics based
-new ability to run by just tappig thumbstick once instead of having to hold down on it

New:
-added improvements to the physics based enemies and ragdoll system overall
-made human soldiers to be physics based and grippable
-added muzzle smoke for guns (activated when 10 or more rounds are shot quickly)
-added backpack mechanics for story mode 
-added gun malfunction mechanic to semi auto guns (currently occurs for 1 in 5000 shots, will be different for story mode)
-added slight scaling effect for recoil reduction when two handing, where recoil will scale and reduce depending on how far apart your two hands are when holding the gun (ie. holding the gun with two hands closely won't reduce the recoil as much as holding the gun with the left hand further down the barrel)
-added mag palming mechanic, hold a mag and hover it near an already attached magazine, press and hold X on your left hand to activate mag palming
-added realistic bullet tracer wiggling effect (similar to games like MW2)
-added PP19 Vityaz (PDW) 
-added ability to run by just tapping the left thumbstick once (previously you needed to hold down)

notes.title: Update 20 is here - Shoulder lock (virtual stock), M67 Grenades, and more
notes.content:
Changelog - Update 20

Main Features:
-You can now activate physics based shoulder lock anywhere on your body, shoulders, chin, hips, forehead, etc. Hold your gun's stock near your shoulders, and double tap your hand's thumbstick to activate shoulder lock. A blue circle will show up inticating the shoulder lock position. Double tap again to deactivate shoulder lock. The shoulder lock position is fixed based on where you activate it, so you need to position your gun to your desired position first.
-Aiming down sights should now be almost as close to real life as possible, with the new physics based shoulder lock system
-Added M67 grenade. Use trigger grip to pull pin. You can also cook the grenade by pressing trigger on your holding hand after pulling the pin out.

New:
-added physics based shoulder lock mechanic, hold gun near your shoulder and double tap your hand's thumbstick to activate/deactivate. 
-added M67 grenade (ordinance)
-added 5.45x39mm round, fixed AK12's caliber to be 5.45x39mm
-added hand snap points for the fixed grips of certain guns (AUG A1 and A3, MP5K, Striker, M60)
-added mechanism for pistols where secondary grips will only affect the gun direction if it is held far enough away from main hand, or is holding on to a grip attachment

Changes:
-changed eotech's reticle back to previous reticle
-changed pso-1 scope's reticle to more realistic version
-fixed issue where magazines would drop through item spawners table when spawning
-made bullet optimizations for fps and performance
-optimized blood impact fx and reduced lag time when first spawning blood impacts
-fixed issue where controllers would continue to rumble after firing last round on auto for some guns
-fixed M79 grenade launch sound being too low pitched for some reason
